reviewItem.question: Does "If you have configured `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` or its YAML setting: - If it matches the value of `object_store` for all the periods that use `tsdb` as…" mean a change to cli-flag:loki|name=-tsdb.shipper.shared-store (removed)?

proposed.statement: The -tsdb.shipper.shared-store option is removed; if its value differed from object_store for a tsdb period, the index for that period becomes inaccessible until index tables are moved or copied to the object_store store.
